question: The connecting wires used in an electric circuit are usually made of-
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Copper **is one of the **good conductor **of electricity.
 
• **Copper **is used for electrical wiring due to the reason that it is a **good conductor **of electricity. 
 
• The **free electrons **in metals can pass through the metal, by **allowing **metals to conduct electricity.
 
• **Copper **being more ductile, it is **commonly **used in making **thin wires**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Silver **is the best conductor of **electricity **however copper is used instead of silver for making wires.
 
• **Silver **is difficult to **bend**, and it is very expensive.
 
• **Plastic **is a **non-conducting **material. Widely used to **insulate **electric wiring.
 
• **Gold **is also another commonly used metal in **wires **and cables. It's generally coated around other **metal strands**.
 
• Because it's an **expensive **metal to use as the **sole **conductor.
